acceptance: Documents, frames and open shadow roots are enumerated at any depth; cross-origin, sandboxed, policy-blocked and unreadable regions become opaque placeholders with origin and reason and no content; closed roots are seen only with the extension API; the runtime advertises its limits.

positive.fixture: 7 browser and 5 unit tests plus the extension spec: nested shadow roots entered, extension sees closed content

negative.fixture: a cross-origin frame carrying the same secret text is never read; an ungranted origin is refused; depth limits become placeholders

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Scope discovery is one tree walk per scope; custom elements that may hide closed roots are counted, not probed.
known_limitations: Page-context scripts cannot see closed shadow roots or cross-origin frames; both are reported as limits
